text:
Rafa: Flagging an issue: Tax liabilities in NetSuite don't match Stripe for a batch of EU invoices from yesterday. NetSuite entries show 0 VAT for several German customers but Stripe collected VAT.
Priya: Oof. Which customers + amounts?
Rafa: ACCT-DE-21 (VAT €120), ACCT-DE-34 (VAT €45), ACCT-IE-09 (VAT €30). NetSuite posted invoice totals but tax lines are missing jurisdiction and tax code is blank. Stripe has tax={amounts above} and tax_rates applied.
Zane: Quick trace: tax-sync maps Stripe tax_rate.id -> NS tax_code. Our mapping table relies on stripe_tax_id but the nightly-tax-job was updated in the last deploy to prefer stripe_tax_name for lookups (to support new EU experiment). The problem: some tax names contain the region suffix e.g., "VAT (DE)" vs "VAT", so lookup failed and we created NS records without tax lines.
Priya: Immediate ledger impact? are amounts posted to GL already?
Netsuite-admin: Invoices posted but tax liability account shows under-collected €195. NetSuite allowed posting without tax code but the tax reporting will be wrong. We can create manual tax journals but Finance approval required for >€100 adjustments per account.
Tax-team-bot: nightly-tax-job run id=tax-2026-03-29-01 triggered mapping-change feature flag:use_tax_name=true at 2315000200 :information_source:
Rafa: So feature flag caused fallback to name-based mapping which failed for region-suffixed names.
Zane: Proposed immediate fixes:
1) Rollback feature flag use_tax_name=false (5m) to restore stripe_tax_id lookups.
2) Run a reconciliation to find NetSuite invoices with null tax_code and match them to Stripe tax entries (script, ~30m).
3) For posted invoices, create balancing tax liability journals for the missing VAT amounts and tag with FIN ticket. Netsuite-admin will prepare journals but needs Priya sign-off for >€100 per account.
4) Long term: enhance mapping to normalize tax names and prefer id with name fallback and add contract tests.
Priya: Approve journals for ACCT-DE-21 (€120) and ACCT-DE-34 (€45) and ACCT-IE-09 (€30) (all under sign-off threshold). Proceed with journals and reconciliation. Also please include evidence links in FIN-3601.
Netsuite-admin: I'll draft the tax liability journals and set them to Pending Approval until Priya signs. Preparing script to identify affected invoices now.
Rafa: I'll attach Stripe payload samples and logs to FIN-3601. Example stripe event: `{"id":"evt_tax_9a2","type":"invoice.created","data":{"object":{"id":"in_9a2","customer":"cus_DE21","tax":{"amount":120,"rate":"txr_vat_de"}}}}`
Zane: Rolling back flag now and redeploying tax-sync (rollback timestamp 2315000225). After rollback, nightly-tax-job will use stripe_tax_id again.
Tax-team-bot: feature-flag/use_tax_name set to false by zane at 2315000226 :white_check_mark:
Netsuite-admin: Found 18 invoices with missing tax_code across DE/IE; total missing VAT €1,380. I'll generate journals grouped by customer and set to Pending at 2315000240.
Priya: Approved grouping journals for customers where each account's adjustment < €500. For any grouped customer totals >€500, escalate to CFO.
Rafa: Will run reconciliation script after rollback and generate mapping file showing stripe_id -> ns_invoice_id pairs for auditing.
Zane: After reconciliation we should re-run the nightly reporting job in dry-run and verify no further tax misses. Also adding a unit test to the tax mapping service to cover "VAT (DE)", "VAT-DE", "VAT" variants.
Netsuite-admin: Draft journals attached to FIN-3601 at 2315000255. Waiting for Priya approval to post.
Priya: Approved posting for the flagged journals. Post them and include a memo referencing FIN-3601.
Netsuite-admin: Posted journals at 2315000268 and updated FIN-3601. Tax liabilities reconciled and GL balanced for affected accounts.
Rafa: Added log excerpts and mapping patch to FIN-3601. Long-term action items: normalize tax name inputs, strict id-first mapping, and an alert for invoices posted without tax_code.
Zane: I'll open PR for normalization + tests (PR #452) and add alert when tax_code is null on posted invoice.
Tax-team-bot: alert rule created: NS invoices with null tax_code -> email finance at 2315000275 :bell:
Priya: Thanks team. Owners: Zane (code + rollback + tests), Netsuite-admin (journals + posting), Rafa (investigation + FIN ticket). Target: rollback immediate, journals posted within 1hr, PR and alert in follow-up. Closing thread once FIN-3601 is finalized.
